focus: Runtime adapter parity and untrusted spec-folder input
noveltyJustification: Four findings are fully new adapter-parity defects and one extends the iteration-1 target-resolution evidence into all five adapters.
answeredQuestions: Do the runtime adapters (Claude, OpenCode plugin, Pi, Codex, Hermes) implement the same trigger, arm and nudge semantics as the core, and where do they drift?

label: handoffText interpolates the spec-folder value into note frontmatter without validation, so a newline-bearing adapter value can inject frontmatter keys.
Malformed claim seeds are refused by Hermes but converted into instructions naming the placeholder <handoff-path> by Claude, Codex and OpenCode.
Killer target resolution is reimplemented five ways; only Codex and Hermes use the core ancestor walk, while Claude uses CLAUDE_PID or process.ppid and Pi/OpenCode use process.pid.
The OpenCode plugin treats a note file's existence as handoff done but a read failure as still open, so a corrupt note permanently suppresses the nudge.
The environment reference says Claude and Codex take spec_folder from the hook payload, but no repository hook or host configuration produces that field; only tests set it.
